name: Nightmare
description: Few dare to approach these tanks, but those who conquer the chilling horror of a thousand faces screaming in eternal agony will know no fear. You will become a Nightmare incarnate. Rumors say that every kill made with paint will add one more howling soul.
interestingFacts: This paint was available in the Shop as part of a special Halloween bundle during the 2017 Halloween celebrations from October 29 to November 6, 2017, for 59.90 USD.
After beholding this paint, all but the most stout-hearted of tankers dread what they may dream up in the night.
